title: Ride a dog sled near Fairbanks
description: Meet a working sled-dog team before climbing into a passenger sled, then listen as excited barking gives way to runners gliding over snow. A musher guides the dogs through forest trails and explains how the team communicates and trains. It is a chance to feel an Alaskan winter tradition from inside the sled, with the dogs very much the stars.
teaser: Meet the dogs, then glide through snowy forest.
goodToKnow: The sled ride can be bumpy. Ask the operator about boarding, weight limits and how the ride feels before reserving.
whyItMightDelightYou: The instant the dogs begin to run turns a quiet landscape into a shared, energetic ride.
